SOURCE: Fathom (via HubSpot internal notes) — https://fathom.video/share/6N5xtzDhCSwEyQy_kvvXKahJeZkzbQtw

AI Meeting Summary ✨

Generated by Fathom // View Recording (37 mins - No highlights)

Meeting Purpose

To explore SMB team's services for scaling Swift Law North.

Key Takeaways

Goal: Swift Law North (SLN) aims to scale from 30–40 to 100+ new clients/month, targeting high-value Consumer Protection cases (e.g., fraud, identity theft).

Strategy: SMB team proposed a multi-channel ad campaign (PPC, LSAs, social) to build brand awareness and generate quality leads, leveraging SLN's national reach and Spanish-speaking capabilities.

Pricing: SMB team's marketing packages are tailored to ad spend, starting at $7,500/month. A sister company, Attorney Assistant, was recommended for intake support.

Next Step: A follow-up meeting is set for Aug 27 to review a custom marketing proposal with specific cost-per-lead (CPL) data for SLN's target cases.

Topics

Swift Law North (SLN) Profile

Practice: National Consumer Protection firm (3 years old).

Current State: 30–40 new clients/month from referrals/partnerships; no prior paid marketing.

Team: 4 partners (Mike is CTO), ~10 underwriting staff, and an outsourced intake team in India.

Case Value: Wide range, from low tens of thousands to $500k.

Target Cases: High-value cases involving credit report issues, fraud, and identity theft.

Scaling Capacity: Confident in handling double the current client volume (60–80/month).

Scaling Goal & Strategy

Primary Goal: Scale to 100+ new clients/month.

Ultimate Vision: Reach 500 new clients/month.

Proposed Strategy: A multi-channel ad campaign to build brand awareness and generate quality leads.

PPC, LSAs, and social media campaigns.

Connected TV ads (ESPN, Hulu).

Virtual avatars for daily content across platforms.

Key Advantage: SLN's national reach and Spanish-speaking capabilities create a less competitive, more cost-effective ad market.

SMB team Services & Pricing

Full-Service Offering: A "growth acceleration system" with four pillars:

Lead Generation: Multi-channel digital marketing.

Teams & Ops: Coaching, fractional COO support.

Intake & Profits: Systems optimization to improve conversion rates.

AI & Tech: Custom LLM software and fractional CTO support.

Pricing Model: Marketing packages are tailored to ad spend.

Smallest Package: Manages up to $7,500/month in ad spend.

Largest Packages: Manage up to $150k+/month in ad spend.

Intake Support: Attorney Assistant, a sister company, was recommended to supplement SLN's outsourced team.

Next Steps

Jacob:

Email Mike: recap of the AI webinar, info for the Sept 16 webinar, and the book "The Law Firm Growth Accelerator."

Consult marketing team for CPL data on SLN's target cases.

Prepare a custom marketing proposal for the follow-up meeting.

Mike & Jacob:

Attend follow-up meeting on Aug 27 at 1:30 PM ET to review the proposal.

Action Items

Confirm no conflict w/ other FL consumer protection clients; update Mike - WATCH (5 secs)
Email Mike: Sep 16 webinar details, past AI recap, book, Attorney Assistant link - WATCH (5 secs)
Send Mike calendar invite for Aug 27 1:30 PM ET follow-up - WATCH (5 secs)
Prepare FL consumer protection lead-cost/CPL report for Mike; include Spanish-language ads - WATCH (5 secs)
